entities.name: Arine
entities.description: Friend of Liliana Vess in her youth who lived at Vess Manor; presumably died in the curse.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker; as a young healer she accidentally turned her brother into a zombie.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's brother, struck by a mage-blade and later turned into a zombie.

entities.name: Vess Manor

events.summary: Arine interrupts Liliana to tell her the battlefield caravan has arrived and Josu was struck by a mage-blade and needs healing.
events.quote: Arine interrupted them to deliver the news that Liliana's brother Josu had been struck by a mage-blade

events.summary: Liliana turns Josu into a zombie unintentionally and the household is struck by a curse.
events.quote: Liliana later turned Josu into a zombie without intending to
